Synopsis:
 Five migrants were found dead aboard a rescued boat off Spain's Canary Islands, with survivor accounts (unverified) suggesting up to 83 additional deaths during the 27-day crossing from The Gambia. Three survivors were airlifted in serious condition; 41 others disembarked at Arguineguin. The Canary Islands' regional leader called for a national migration policy. Despite the tragedy, arrivals to the Canary Islands are down 57.4% year-to-date.
